description: Manifest for the preenfm3 full-render golden-master fixtures. See tests/golden/README.md and _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/golden-master-test-plan.md. Each entry corresponds to one TEST in tests/golden_master_test.cpp. The full render is byte-stable per (libm-class), NOT per compiler: ubuntu gcc and ubuntu clang both link glibc and produce byte-identical renders, while macOS clang links libsystem and differs. The discriminator is the platform/libm; tests/golden_master_test.cpp selects by __APPLE__. FM feedback amplifies the ~1-ULP libm-driven table differences (Osc::init/Env::init precompute via sinf/expf/logf), so cross-libm renders diverge by >1 LSB within ~1 block.

comparison.artifactType: int32_t DAC-format render (3 buffers x 64 stereo per block = 192 int32/block)
comparison.hashAlgorithm: FNV-1a 64-bit over tolerance-normalized buffer + splitmix64 finalizer (self-contained, no system xxhash)
comparison.buildFlag: -ffp-contract=off (tests/CMakeLists.txt) — strict IEEE mul/add, no FMA contraction, for best per-variant reproducibility (does NOT close the cross-libm gap, which is libm-driven)

determinism.scope: per (libm-class): macOS-libsystem and linux-glibc renders differ by >1 LSB within ~1 block (libm-driven table differences amplified by FM feedback); ubuntu gcc and ubuntu clang (both glibc) are byte-identical
determinism.rng: HAL_RNG gated to seed 0 under PFM3_HOST (Synth.cpp:285); downstream noise[] fill loop shared host/firmware
determinism.selfCheck: GoldenMaster.DeterminismSelfCheck renders twice in-process and asserts byte-exact equality (per-variant)

variants.use: CI ubuntu gcc (Host unit tests) + ubuntu clang (Coverage leg)

fixtures.preset: default preenMainPreset (copied by Synth::init into timbre 0)
fixtures.noteSequence: noteOn(timbre=0, note=69 [A4], velocity=100) before block 0; no note-off
fixtures.warmStart: all 200 blocks captured incl. smoothVolume_/smoothPan_ one-pole transient (~blocks 0-10)
fixtures.guards: the entire Synth -> Timbre -> Voice -> Matrix -> FxBus -> int32 mix chain on macOS/libsystem
